notes.title: Regarding the update situation of the "Spirit Connection" major version
notes.notes: [p]Family, long time no see! Due to not updating for a long time, some people in the comments said that I ran away, but in fact, I also ran away. Every morning, I would run for a few minutes to exercise properly and then continue to focus on making large version updates.[/p][p]Regarding this update, there is quite a lot of content, and there are also many exotic beasts updated, as well as many new gameplay elements. This will lead to an increase in bugs, and fixing them will also take a lot of time.[/p][p]How is the current progress? At present, the main gameplay has been basically completed, but there are still gaps in the skills of exotic beasts, the main storyline, and a bunch of bugs.[/p][p]Why not update in batches? Batch updates will take more time in packaging, and the resulting content will be updated less.[/p][p]Also, many people in the comment section say that it's difficult to hit monsters with the operation. In fact, you can first use the V key to pursue close range and then release the skill, which will increase the hit rate.[/p][p]I am here, always there...[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340326/7e81335837327ae28e1d0cdf5ee549f7d94c7962.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340326/40ce141efb96ffb40c25eeb4ff2f5ebf3fb8da8e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340326/b72b1f7586aeb0a98f4fc3c47aa2a506d0b9cdf5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340326/a7ec0a3a9f3c2f7f6815d25940a66ce9586eeb94.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340326/1cdfb3ed1e51a7c571ec71bdfd4e820bb4cd802c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Preview for the Major Version of 'Lingyuan': Injecting Soul into the Game
notes.notes:
Hello family! It has been a year since the last major update of 'Opening an Egg'. The expectation of this major update is to take the game to a new level and bring more fun gameplay, with random events as the main focus and constant surprises. The update trailer is as follows:



Addition: Multiple random events triggered by different conditions, allowing players to make different choices that affect different outcomes

Addition: The main storyline of the game follows the secret of soaring to the upper realm

Add: Multiple secret realm maps that randomly appear around the world or within regions of influence based on time

Add: Multiple gameplay modes, auctions, item synthesis, bloodline, illusion, martial arts competitions, animal fights, gambling stones, and the Sky Tower, etc

Add: Multiple 12th level super divine beasts, divine qilin, nine tailed sky fox, domineering black dragon, awakening form of the Four Spirits of Heaven

Addition: New BOSS - Shadow Lord, players appear after the first unification of the world

Addition: Collection of exotic animal maps, evolved exotic animals will be included in the map

Add: Multiple items and props, including Yi Jing Dan, Tian Tian Di Dan, Jue Neng Cui Ti Dan, Zao Hua Fei Xian Sui, Tian Di Xuan Huang Shen, Xing Xing Shui Yun Zhi, Jiu Xiao Ling Long Guo, etc

Addition: Multiple sets of Supreme Soul Bones, Apocalypse (Wisdom), Dragon Glory (Damage), Holy Emperor (Damage Reduction), Eternal Life (Qi and Blood Restoration), Divine Source (True Qi Restoration), Tai Chi (Automatic Evasion), Reverse Scale (Anti Damage)



This major version update contains a lot of content and is expected to be launched around January 2025. Please stay tuned~

notes.title: June 26th update explanation and update forecast
notes.notes:
Update instructions:
Add: Super Divine Beast - Evil Martial Taowu Online - One of the Four Great Fierce Beasts, Stubborn, Evil and Cruel
Adjustment: Strengthen flight control (reduce inertial motion speed during flight and increase acceleration during flight)

Since the opening of the EA version for testing, most updates have focused on adding gameplay and exotic beasts. However, I have received many letters, most of which have reported that the game operations are complex, and there are many operations that I do not know how to use without checking the operation instructions. Therefore, optimizing and simplifying operations is necessary. The next update will focus on optimizing operations
Update trailer:
1. Simplify operations, eliminate the use of combination keys as much as possible, and adjust the key positions for important operations such as flight, pursuit, descent, etc. to make them easier to apply
2. Optimize character's walking, flying, swimming, and other operations to enhance control
3. Enhance the sense of impact in combat, enhance the feedback and special effects of being hit
4. Add beginner teaching levels and present all basic operations in a teaching style
5. Improve game controller operation and increase support for controller operation in all UI interfaces
6. Reduce the attributes of low-level exotic beasts, making early battles simpler and easier to learn

notes.title: Major update trailer, soul bone equipment system is about to go live
notes.notes:
Du has been online for testing for 9 months and will soon update the soul bone equipment system of exotic beasts. The update forecast is as follows:



Increase: Soul Bone Equipment System Gameplay, killing rare exotic beasts has a chance to drop soul bones. The soul bone parts have left and right corners, left and right shoulders, left and right arms, and left and right wings, with 6 qualities of white, green, blue, purple, orange, and red, and a maximum of 5 attribute entries. The entry includes 5 levels of green, blue, purple, orange, and red, and the higher the quality, the higher the attribute. Soul bone entries and attributes can be refined by consuming spirit stones. In the initial stage, it is expected to increase by 20 sets of soul bones, which can be obtained by exploring different dungeons to kill rare exotic beasts.

notes.title: Major update on November 24th
notes.notes:
Activate: Faction War Gaming

Teleportation stones: The teleportation stones distributed throughout the world correspond to an entrance to a faction area, and enter and exit that faction area through the entrance

Join: Find the teleportation stone of the faction you want to join, middle click on the "Join" button to apply for joining, and once approved, you can become a member of that faction

Treason: After joining a faction, one can defecte. After defecting, one becomes powerless and can rejoin a new faction

Conquer: Select the faction formation stone to be conquered and engage in combat in a way that eliminates all enemies to successfully occupy the faction area

Captive: When the capture is successful, the defeated party will become a captive, and players can surrender, execute, and release the captive

Unification: Complete the unification of the world after capturing all forces

Establishment: When a character has not joined a faction, they can establish a faction after capturing the faction area for the first time and use that faction area as the main battlefield

Recruitment: The faction leader or junior leader can recruit other characters to join the faction

Main position: The fundamental position during the establishment of a force, which is destroyed and disbanded after being breached

Defensive Battle: When attacked by other forces, you can enter defensive battle and successfully defend the force area after repelling the enemy

Position: Players can customize the position name when they are the leader or minor leader of the faction

Establishing a Crown Prince: The power lord can designate a descendant to establish a Crown Prince

Appointment: The position where the power lord or minor lord can appoint members

Recall: The power leader or minor leader can recall a member's position to become the initial position

Exclusion: The faction leader or minor leader can expel members from the faction



Add: 44 faction area maps, which can be accessed and exited through corresponding teleportation arrays

Enable: Divine Sense function, which allows you to explore nearby items by releasing Divine Sense

Add: Set the favorability level between characters to display during character interaction
